artists.biography:
Snuff are a British punk rock band formed in Hendon in 1986. Their name reportedly came about after a long discussion about names ended up with one of them claiming "That's Enough", which was then shortened to Snuff. The original line-up was Duncan Redmonds on drums and vocals, Simon Wells on guitar and vocals and Andy Crighton on bass, with Dave Redmonds being added to the line-up on trombone before the release of Flibbiddydibbiddydob.

Snuff have released their material through a variety of independent record labels including their own, 10past12records, as well as on Fat Wreck Chords a label owned by Fat Mike of NOFX.

perplexity.description:
Flibbiddydibbiddydob is a punk mini-album by British band Snuff, released in 1990 on the Workers Playtime label. The release consists primarily of cover versions and reworked television commercial jingles, presenting a playful yet irreverent approach to the punk genre. The project showcased the band's ability to deconstruct familiar material and reimagine it through their punk sensibility.

The album became the subject of notable industry controversy regarding its classification. Snuff argued that Flibbiddydibbiddydob should be classified as an EP due to its mini-album format, which would have made it eligible for the UK Singles Chart. However, the British Phonographic Industry (BPI) insisted on classifying it as a full album because of its large number of tracks, ultimately denying the band's chart eligibility claim. This dispute highlighted the ambiguous status of the release within the band's catalog and the rigid categorization systems of the era.

Flibbiddydibbiddydob occupies a distinctive position in Snuff's discography as an interim project between their early work and their later full-length studio albums. The release demonstrated the band's experimental approach and willingness to subvert commercial expectations, establishing them as a creative force within the UK punk scene before they would go on to record more conventional albums like Disposable Income in 2003.
